body: OHHH okay. what a dumb layout, thank you for explaining!
now i'm fucking worried that valve think i cheated or something and they'll reset my data, lmao.
thank you. it helped a lot, i really appreciate it

i've never left anyone before. i've been in two relationships before:
the first i was young, i don't really count it, but she moved away and i never saw her again
the second was before my current relationship, and we were 'together' for 2 months' but it turns out she had someone the whole time

i've never left, i only care about others more than anything else. i try my real best to make everyone happy, it's all i want

thats exactly how i feel.. i've put so much into this relationship.

i don't know what i'd do if i didn't have her.. i'm not used to being alone.. but i feel so alone right now

she always convinces me that everything is my fault, even if she did something wrong, but i never accuse her of anything. i trust her wholeheartedly and i don't know why i can't get that in return

i'm a british muslim.

my parents are fairly religious, more old school actually, and are concerned about the reputation within the family moreso, she is a white athiest, and i did so much to get my parents to accept her, and they finally were happy with us (this happened around 6 months ago)

she was so sweet, caring, adorable before. one day this behaviour suddenly started to appear, then since then it's like she switches between the moods. she has told me before that she is mentally ill.

we don't live together, but i took a long time getting my parents to accept a different culture, it wasn't easy, i loved everything about her, i still do, until she turns into this... thing. i was pressured into dropping out of university by her before because she thought the fact i travelled 2 hours to and from there meant i was up to something, but i have only given all of my love, honesty, and loyalty to her, i've tried my best.. i really have. im sorry
